note: ModelRouterClassifier(models).pick(prompt, fallback) -> {model, routed, sure, probabilities, calibrated}. OPT-IN (SPEC §8 Right-size routing). One choice keyed `model` over the user's model options (id -> prose description). Sure (confidence > high and not nearUniform) -> model = the pick, routed true. Unsure, missing or error -> model = fallback (the configured model), routed false. No models -> no call, fallback. The beforeLLM hook uses the turn's configured model as fallback and returns an override `model` only when routed to a different id.
